treatment_summary: Increase lisinopril to 20 mg daily and amlodipine to 5 mg daily, and replace hydrochlorothiazide with indapamide SR 1.5 mg daily to achieve NICE NG136 recommended triple therapy for hypertension with CKD. Monitor renal function, electrolytes (K⁺, Na⁺) and blood pressure after changes. Obtain missing labs (eGFR, potassium, HbA1c, BMI) and calculate QRISK. Continue fluoxetine and insulin as currently prescribed. Provide lifestyle advice (salt <6 g/day, DASH diet, weight loss, exercise, limit alcohol, smoking cessation, CPAP adherence).
